description: A deeply conversational task teaching preschoolers how to count happy and sad faces.

engage.description: Engage the student with emotional faces.
engage.speech_start: Look. Happy face. . Look. Sad face.
engage.speech_middle: Let's count. . One. . Two. . Three. . Four. . Five.
engage.speech_end: Again, let's count. . One. . Two. . Three. . Four. . Five. . Say okey after finish

explore.description: Explore the student with emotional faces.
explore.speech_start: Look!! Small group of happy faces.
explore.speech_middle: Big group of sad faces. Small group of sad faces.
explore.speech_end: Big group of Happy faces. Very Good!!. . Say Okey.

explain.description: Teach that faces can be counted.
explain.speech_start: One sad face. Two sad faces. Three sad faces. One happy face.
explain.speech_end: Two happy faces. Three happy faces. Great counting!

elaborate.task_title: Guided Example - Count the Happy Faces

multiple_choices_speech.op1: Look here. One. Two. Only 2. Not this one.
multiple_choices_speech.op2: Let's check this one. One. Two. Three. Four. Four is too many.
multiple_choices_speech.op3: What about this one? Just one. Not enough.
multiple_choices_speech.op4: Now look here. One. Two. Three. Wow! 3 happy faces. This is the answer.

multiple_choices_speech.op2: Or this one. Is this it?
multiple_choices_speech.op4: Or this one. Is this it?
